---
name: ✨ Feature request / improvement / suggestion
about: Suggest an idea, an improvement or a new feature
title: "Feature: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / need

What is missing or awkward today? What are you trying to achieve?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or improvement you would like (screenshots / mockups welcome).

## How would you use it?

A short concrete example (e.g. "when writing a dialogue in Godot later, I'd want…").

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same need (existing features, workarounds…), and why they don't fit.

## Additional context

Anything else: related issues, links, constraints (mobile, offline, desktop app…).
